title: Evaporating Liquidity
one_line: Short-term reversal returns (a proxy for paid liquidity provision) are predictable with the VIX: expected returns and Sharpe ratios spike when VIX rises in turmoil (e.g. 2007-09), even for industry portfolios that earn little on average.

findings.statement: Reversal strategy returns vary strongly over time and are predicted by VIX.
Industry-level reversal earns little on average but a lot when VIX is high.

why.pattern: Liquidity provision is paid more when intermediaries withdraw (high VIX).

reported_results.headline: Short-term reversal returns (a proxy for paid liquidity provision) are predictable with the VIX: expected returns and Sharpe ratios spike when VIX rises in turmoil (e.g. 2007-09), even for industry portfolios that earn little on average.

tradable_edge: Index angle (speculative): short-term reversal in ES works mainly in high-volatility regimes — a regime filter for the overnight-reversal spec.
data_fit: Cross-sectional; the ES version would be a regime filter only.
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 3), not by the weekly pipeline.
